title: Query log: a self-improving lookup pipeline
goal: Every kb lookup leaves a redacted, judged record in kb/_querylog/; learn turns records into findings and apply turns accepted findings into eval rows, aliases, expansions and _gaps.md entries, pushed straight to main once the local gate passes (kb/_self/querylog.md is the design).
notes: Work cost (ST-fria7ro7 to ST-ecacczzu): per-item token lines in kb/_querylog/work/, joined to items by id; tokens only, no prices. ST-zptutwlf reads them through backlog.py cost. Not planned yet: a per-kind baseline that flags an item far over its peers in horizon.
